items.q: Do you work in English, Turkish and Romanian?
items.a: All three. Meetings in whichever you prefer.

items.q: Can you take over an unfinished project?
items.a: Often yes. We do a 90-minute audit on the codebase, then send a recovery plan.

items.q: Do you only do new builds?
items.a: No. Half of our work is rescuing or rebuilding what someone else started.
Most clients keep us on a monthly retainer after launch. Optional, never required.

hero.heading: Twelve recent projects.
hero.sub: Every client is real. Every screenshot is the live site. Dates are when the project shipped.

lavinia-bistro-qr-menu.title: A QR menu that paid for itself in 8 weeks
lavinia-bistro-qr-menu.problem: Lavinia ran four bistros across Bucharest. Each had its own printed menu, updated by hand, in two languages. Every menu change cost a full day. Tourists couldn't read the Romanian. Allergens were a sticky note on the back of the bar.
lavinia-bistro-qr-menu.approach: We built one menu that serves four locations. Owners edit dishes in a Google-sheet-style admin. Each menu auto-translates to EN/TR/DE/RO and renders at the QR. Allergens, photos and prices are properties of the dish, not the menu.
lavinia-bistro-qr-menu.outcome: Print costs gone. Tip share up 11%. Two restaurants in the neighbourhood asked to license the platform.

rain-group-ecommerce.title: Shopify + Meta Ads — ROAS 3.4× for a full quarter
rain-group-ecommerce.problem: Rain Group had two stores on a shared theme, no creative system, and a Meta account that had not been audited in 18 months. ROAS was bouncing between 1.1× and 1.9×.
rain-group-ecommerce.approach: We rebuilt the Shopify theme as one codebase with two skins. Cleaned up the pixel and conversion API. Designed a creative system of five formats × three angles, run weekly.
rain-group-ecommerce.stack: Shopify · Liquid · Meta Conversion API · Figma
rain-group-ecommerce.outcome: ROAS held at 3.4× across Q1. Email captured 28% of new sessions. Average order value up 17%.

drsevim-beauty-clinic.title: A clinic website that actually books appointments
drsevim-beauty-clinic.problem: Dr. Sevim's old site looked good but did not let patients book. Every appointment came through Instagram DMs. The clinic was paying a part-time staffer just to chase the inbox.
drsevim-beauty-clinic.approach: New site with a real booking flow. WhatsApp confirmation, calendar sync, deposit via iyzico, reminders 24h and 2h before. A small admin for the clinic team.
drsevim-beauty-clinic.outcome: +38% bookings in the first quarter. Time-to-confirm dropped from 4 hours to under 5 minutes. DMs back to being DMs.

tp-thermoplast-b2b.title: Live export data, six markets, one dashboard
tp-thermoplast-b2b.problem: TP exports plastics to six countries. Sales reported in six different spreadsheets, in three currencies, with monthly lag. The CEO was making pricing decisions on stale data.
tp-thermoplast-b2b.approach: We built a nightly ETL that pulls orders, FX rates and shipping costs from each system, normalises them, and renders a single dashboard. Alerts when margin drops below a threshold.
tp-thermoplast-b2b.outcome: All six markets live. Decision cycle from 7 days to next-morning. Two products repriced based on the first month of data.

eduturkia-platform.title: A student platform that brought in 60% more applicants
eduturkia-platform.problem: EduTurkia helps international students apply to Turkish universities. The old funnel was a static site plus a Google Form. Drop-off was brutal, and the SEO was a mess of duplicate pages.
eduturkia-platform.approach: New site, real application flow, document upload, status tracking, agent dashboard. A content system that publishes per-university pages with proper schema markup.
eduturkia-platform.outcome: +60% organic traffic Q1. Application completion rate went from 24% to 51%. Featured in 3 Turkish ed-tech roundups.

clown3d-creative-studio.title: A portfolio site for a creative studio that earns its name
clown3d-creative-studio.problem: Clown3D is a 3D / motion studio with very high-end work and a website that did not reflect it. Their reel kept losing leads at the homepage.
clown3d-creative-studio.approach: A site that gets out of the way of the work. Heavy video, light copy, opinionated typography. Built with WebGL where it earns its keep, plain HTML elsewhere.
clown3d-creative-studio.stack: Next.js · React Three Fiber · Mux · Sanity
clown3d-creative-studio.outcome: Featured on Awwwards two weeks after launch. Two new retainer clients within a month.

ataravci-law-firm.title: A law firm site + a quiet cloud migration
ataravci-law-firm.problem: Atar Avcı had outgrown their old shared host. The site was slow. The case-file system lived on a dusty VPS that nobody wanted to touch.
ataravci-law-firm.approach: New site with practice-area pages and a secure contact form. The case-file system was lifted onto AWS with proper backups, encrypted at rest, behind a Cloudflare gateway.
ataravci-law-firm.outcome: Site loads in under a second. Migration finished in two weekends with no downtime. Hosting + ops bill: €3,400 / month lower.

novahealth-cloud-migration.title: Migrating a clinic group to AWS without dropping a request
novahealth-cloud-migration.problem: Nova Health's appointment system was on a single VPS, with the database on the same box and no proper backup. A single power blip would have cancelled a day of appointments.
novahealth-cloud-migration.approach: Moved the app to ECS Fargate, RDS Postgres with PITR, S3 for media, CloudFront in front. Set up alerts and on-call rotation with us as backup for the first quarter.
novahealth-cloud-migration.outcome: 99.97% uptime Q1. Zero appointments lost during migration. Recovery time objective dropped from 'pray' to 15 minutes.

marmara-foods-google-ads.title: Cutting CAC by 41% with a smaller, sharper ad account
marmara-foods-google-ads.problem: Marmara was running 38 ad groups across 4 campaigns, mostly losing money. The landing pages had been built by a different agency two years ago and never updated.
marmara-foods-google-ads.approach: We killed 70% of the keywords. Rewrote three landing pages so they answered the buyer's question in the first scroll. Built a tight remarketing flow.
marmara-foods-google-ads.outcome: CAC down 41%. Spend reduced 30%, revenue flat at first and up 14% in month two.

skyline-media-mobile-app.title: An iOS + Android app for a media brand, shipped in 12 weeks
skyline-media-mobile-app.problem: Skyline had a strong website and a podcast but no app. Listeners kept asking for offline downloads and push when a new episode dropped.
skyline-media-mobile-app.approach: React Native app. Offline downloads via background fetch. Push via Expo + APNs / FCM. Deep links from the website to the app for episode pages.
skyline-media-mobile-app.outcome: 70k installs in the first quarter. 4.7★ on iOS, 4.6★ on Android. Average session 14 minutes.

bosporus-travel-ai-agent.title: An AI agent that books trips in three languages
bosporus-travel-ai-agent.problem: Bosporus' inbox had EN, TR and RU tourists asking the same 20 questions. Their two-person team was answering every one by hand, often outside hours.
bosporus-travel-ai-agent.approach: A WhatsApp + web-chat agent trained on their FAQ and inventory. It books test-drive trips, sends quotes and hands off to a human when it's not sure.
bosporus-travel-ai-agent.stack: Anthropic Claude · WhatsApp Business API · Supabase
bosporus-travel-ai-agent.outcome: 63% of chats resolved by the agent. Response time from 4h to under 2 minutes. The team handles only the interesting questions now.

anatolia-hotel-booking.title: A direct booking engine that cuts OTA fees
anatolia-hotel-booking.problem: Anatolia was paying 18–24% per booking to OTAs. Their own site let guests look but not book. Every direct guest had to email.
anatolia-hotel-booking.approach: Custom booking engine that reads availability from their PMS, takes a deposit via iyzico, and confirms in three languages. Plus a small offer engine for return guests.
anatolia-hotel-booking.outcome: Direct bookings up 34% in the first quarter. OTA share of revenue dropped from 71% to 49%. Saved roughly 22% on commissions.

story.heading: What we make
body: Software businesses use to run, sell and grow. Websites with personality. E-commerce that checks out. Mobile apps that ship. AI agents that hold a conversation. Interfaces that earn the click.
Every project is led by someone who wrote the code and drew the screens. No account managers. No outsourcing to teams we've never met.
We pick the right tool for the brief, not the one we want to bill for.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Velkina is a small studio. We collect only what we need to reply to your project inquiry: name, company, email and what you wrote. We do not sell your data, we do not run ad-retargeting on this site, and we delete inquiries after twelve months unless they become projects. For projects, the privacy terms are in the contract we sign with you.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: This website is published by Velkina, a software studio operating from Istanbul and Bucharest. Nothing on this site is a binding offer; every project is governed by the contract we sign with the client. Trade and tax registration are listed on the contract.
